item.title: AI antibiotic discovery
item.description: Note: This is an old post that I had to do for an undergrad project, I want to leave it here as something to compare my newer work to. Enjoy! Antibiotic discovery could be one of the greatest medical paradoxes of modern times. It is increasingly difficult to discover new antibiotics, with market forces being a major factor slowing development. It takes decades and costs billions to develop new antibiotics, the announcement of a new antibiotic is often accompanied by a drop in stock value, with the developers often going out of business.

item.title: Making Parasites Glow
item.description: Note: This is an old post that I had to do for an undergrad project, I want to leave it here as something to compare my newer work to. Enjoy! For the 4th year of my MSci I’m working in the Tewari lab. A lab that specialises in understanding specific proteins, their roles and locations in Plasmodium, the group of parasites that causes malaria. One of the most useful tools used is fluorescent microscopy.
